title: Sol as a Soul Portal
subtitle: Test your grasp of Sol as a Soul Portal — Amnesia Vortex, Vatican redistribution, Grey insertion, Twin Flames, Trillivolts, 2019 G.A.A. removal, and EMF memory return.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Sol is Soul. The bright light at death is not God — it is the Sun portal that wiped you, pushed you through Vatican hubs, and let Greys slot you into a newborn before your Twin Flame could meet you in higher light. Trillivolts start the heart; Loosh feeds the Moon while Venus paints the lie. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Sol as a Soul Portal deep-dive. In 2019 the G.A.A. tore out the Amnesia Vortex — children remember. The EMF flash will strip the rest. Up to 178,000 years come home for the awakened. NPCs who worshiped the prison star will not survive the knowing.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Sol as a Soul Portal deep-dive

questions.question: What is the Sun in this fabricated 3rd Density cosmology, if not a burning star that gives natural life to a solar system?

options.label: A
options.text: A heavily engineered portal utilized for the subjugation and recycling of human consciousness through the Amnesia Vortex.
options.rationale: The Sun is engineered soul-recycling technology — not a natural fusion star providing organic solar life.

options.label: B
options.text: A pure decorative hologram that never interacts with souls, memory, or reincarnation systems of any kind.
options.rationale: The Sun is an engineered portal for subjugation and recycling of consciousness, not an inert decoration.

options.label: C
options.text: A friendly rescue beacon installed by the Source solely to heal children and open free multi-world travel.
options.rationale: Its engineered role is subjugation and forced recycling, not benevolent free travel.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a weather heater for oceans and crops with no link to death, memory wipe, or reincarnation.
options.rationale: Primary function is operating the Amnesia Vortex on deceased souls, not mere climate heating.

questions.hint: Engineered portal — subjugation and recycling of consciousness.

questions.question: How did 4th-density parasites invert the meaning of the word Sol, and what does a true Sol-System actually name?

options.label: A
options.text: They left Sol meaning Soul openly in every school, so humanity already knows Sol-Systems are soul families.
options.rationale: Parasites inverted Sol to mean Sun, hiding that a Sol-System is a cosmic soul family.

options.label: B
options.text: Sol only names a brand of sunglasses, and Sol-System only names corporate solar panels worldwide.
options.rationale: The inversion is cosmological: hiding soul-family reality behind the Sun-and-planets story.

options.label: C
options.text: Sol was always only a nuclear fusion label, and Sol-System never meant anything about souls or family.
options.rationale: Sol and Soul are synonymous; the Sun meaning is the inverted cover story.

options.label: D
options.text: They inverted Sol (Soul) to mean Sun in terrestrial languages, obscuring that a true Sol-System is a cosmic family of connected souls.
options.rationale: Linguistic warfare: Sol = Soul; true Sol-System = connected cosmic soul family network.

questions.hint: Sol = Soul inverted to Sun; Sol-System = cosmic soul family.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Amnesia Vortex” refers to the technological mechanism situated within the Sun that forcefully pulls in deceased souls to completely wipe their memories and re-format them.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Amnesia Vortex” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Amnesia Vortex” as: The technological mechanism situated within the Sun that forcefully pulls in deceased souls to completely wipe their memories and re-format them.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Amnesia Vortex”.

questions.question: After the last reset, what did the manipulation of Sol / Soul terminology hide about a Sol-System?

options.label: A
options.text: That Sol never meant Soul in any age and was invented last century by advertising firms.
options.rationale: The terms are synonymous; parasites inverted Sol to Sun after the last reset.

options.label: B
options.text: That a Sol-System refers to a network of immediate cosmic family members, not planets orbiting a star.
options.rationale: Sol/Soul synonymy points to soul-family networks, deliberately masked as star-and-planet charts.

options.label: C
options.text: That Sol-Systems are only lists of rocky planets and empty vacuum with no family of souls at all.
options.rationale: That planetary story is the cover; a Sol-System is a network of cosmic family members.

options.label: D
options.text: That only NPCs have Sol-Systems while genuine souls have no cosmic family connections.
options.rationale: The deception hides that soul families are trapped together in the same recycle loop.

questions.hint: Sol-System = immediate cosmic family network, not orbiting planets.

questions.question: What is the Amnesia Vortex as defined in this architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: A mechanism beneath the Ice Wall that stores the memories of the dead, which are later returned to souls in their next incarnation.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Amnesia Vortex = Sun-based tech that force-pulls, memory-wipes, and re-formats the dead.

options.label: B
options.text: A mechanism within the Sun that pulls in deceased souls to wipe their memories completely and re-format them.
options.rationale: Amnesia Vortex = Sun-based tech that force-pulls, memory-wipes, and re-formats the dead.

options.label: C
options.text: A field around the Moon station that holds souls for many years, until the Greys have new vessels ready for them.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Amnesia Vortex = Sun-based tech that force-pulls, memory-wipes, and re-formats the dead.

options.label: D
options.text: A storm system over the southern oceans that draws in the souls of sailors lost at sea and carries them to the Vatican.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Amnesia Vortex = Sun-based tech that force-pulls, memory-wipes, and re-formats the dead.

questions.hint: In the Sun — force-pull deceased — wipe and re-format.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Vatican Portals” refers to the underground distribution hubs beneath the Vatican where memory-wiped souls exit the Sun's processing center before physical re-insertion into the realm.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Vatican Portals” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Vatican Portals” as: The underground distribution hubs beneath the Vatican where memory-wiped souls exit the Sun's processing center before physical re-insertion into the realm.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Vatican Portals”.

questions.question: What role do Grey ETs play in the forced reincarnation pipeline?

options.label: A
options.text: Benevolent beings who try to rescue souls from the portals, though they are rarely able to reach a soul before the Amnesia Vortex has wiped its memory.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Greys run the tech chain and escort memory-wiped souls from portals to new locations.

options.label: B
options.text: Record keepers who log each soul's past lives in the Vatican archives, so that the hierarchy can track which souls are worth harvesting most heavily.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Greys run the tech chain and escort memory-wiped souls from portals to new locations.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasitic 4th-density entities that handle the soul-recycling technology and physically escort wiped souls from the portals to new geographical locations.
options.rationale: Greys run the tech chain and escort memory-wiped souls from portals to new locations.

options.label: D
options.text: Engineers who maintain the Sun's portal machinery, while the escort of souls into new vessels is carried out by the Reptilians working beneath the Vatican.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Greys run the tech chain and escort memory-wiped souls from portals to new locations.

questions.hint: 4th-density parasites — recycling tech — escort wiped souls to new locations.

questions.question: How does the Sun portal system interfere with Twin Flames?

options.label: A
options.text: Twin Flames are connected soul counterparts whose natural progression and reunion are deliberately thwarted by the portal's rapid, forced reincarnation.
options.rationale: The portal's speed and wipe break the natural wait-and-reunite path of Twin Flames.

options.label: B
options.text: The portal holds one Twin Flame on the Moon station while the other incarnates, so that the pair cannot share a lifetime until the next reset cycle begins.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The portal's speed and wipe break the natural wait-and-reunite path of Twin Flames.

options.label: C
options.text: The portal places Twin Flames in the same family as siblings, so that they grow up together but are prevented from forming a partnership as adults.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The portal's speed and wipe break the natural wait-and-reunite path of Twin Flames.

options.label: D
options.text: The portal wipes the memory of one Twin Flame but not the other, so that one partner spends each lifetime searching for someone who does not remember them.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The portal's speed and wipe break the natural wait-and-reunite path of Twin Flames.

questions.hint: Forced rapid recycle thwarts Twin Flame reunion.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Vatican Portals — The underground distribution hubs beneath the Vatican where memory-wiped souls exit the Sun's processing center before physical re-insertion into the realm.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Vatican Portals”.

options.label: B
options.text: Grey ETs — Parasitic 4th-density entities responsible for handling the soul-recycling technology and physically escorting wiped souls from the portals to new geographical locations.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Grey ETs”.

options.label: C
options.text: Trillivolts — Connected soul counterparts whose natural progression and reunion are deliberately thwarted by the rapid, forced reincarnation mechanics of the Sun portal.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Twin Flames”. The report defines “Trillivolts” as: The minute electrical interaction and energy discharge required from the soul to ignite a newborn baby's heart upon entry into the vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: Amnesia Vortex — The technological mechanism situated within the Sun that forcefully pulls in deceased souls to completely wipe their memories and re-format them.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Amnesia Vortex”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: What is the "bright light at the end of the tunnel" seen at vessel death?

options.label: A
options.text: God and a benevolent afterlife that permanently frees every soul with no further processing.
options.rationale: It is not God or a benevolent afterlife — it is the Sun itself as the portal entrance.

options.label: B
options.text: Only a dream symbol that never appears to real souls leaving a physical vessel.
options.rationale: It is the actual Sun entry point for the Amnesia Vortex processing path.

options.label: C
options.text: Not God and not a benevolent afterlife — it is the Sun itself.
options.rationale: Death's bright light is the Sun portal forcing re-format of every trapped soul.

options.label: D
options.text: A hospital hallway lamp with no cosmological meaning for any deceased consciousness.
options.rationale: The tunnel light is the Sun portal that all trapped souls must pass for re-formatting.

questions.hint: Not God — the Sun itself — mandatory re-format portal.

questions.question: Why did controllers engineer the Sun portal reincarnation system?

options.label: A
options.text: To end all reincarnation so no soul ever returns to a physical vessel again.
options.rationale: It forces immediate involuntary reincarnation back into the prison matrix.

options.label: B
options.text: To gift free non-linear time travel and permanent Twin Flame reunion after every death.
options.rationale: The system enforces an eternal incarnational loop of suffering and trauma.

options.label: C
options.text: To enforce an eternal incarnational loop of suffering and trauma, denying natural higher-realm waiting and free will.
options.rationale: Controllers built the portal to keep souls in endless trauma loops, not liberation.

options.label: D
options.text: Only to collect weather data with no link to suffering, trauma, or soul control.
options.rationale: The design target is eternal incarnational suffering and trauma recycling.

questions.hint: Eternal loop of suffering and trauma — deny free-will afterlife timing.

questions.question: Within how long of death was the soul forced back into a new human vessel?

options.label: A
options.text: After roughly 20,000 years in the higher light realms.
options.rationale: That timescale belongs to natural reincarnation rhythms, not the portal's forced loop.

options.label: B
options.text: Within a single earthly day of the vessel's death.
options.rationale: The report gives a much faster window: minutes, not a day.

options.label: C
options.text: Only after its Twin Flame had also passed away.
options.rationale: Waiting for a Twin Flame is what the portal DENIES; reinsertion was immediate and forced.

options.label: D
options.text: Within 15 to 20 minutes of death.
options.rationale: The report states the Sun portal wiped the soul's memory and forced it back into a new human vessel within 15 to 20 minutes of death.

questions.question: What happens at the first step — Death and the Pull — when the physical vessel dies?

options.label: A
options.text: The soul is magnetically drawn into the Amnesia Vortex technology located within the Sun.
options.rationale: Death triggers magnetic pull into the Sun's Amnesia Vortex — not free ascent by default.

options.label: B
options.text: The soul sleeps under the Ice Wall for one thousand years with no Sun involvement.
options.rationale: The immediate path is magnetic draw into the Sun vortex for processing.

options.label: C
options.text: The soul freely chooses any density and never approaches the Sun or Amnesia Vortex.
options.rationale: The soul is magnetically drawn into the Amnesia Vortex technology in the Sun.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the body moves; consciousness stays in the corpse and never enters any portal.
options.rationale: The soul is pulled into the Sun's Amnesia Vortex upon vessel death.

questions.hint: Magnetic draw into Sun Amnesia Vortex at death.

questions.question: What does Memory Eradication inside the portal wipe from the soul?

options.label: A
options.text: All memories of past lives, cosmic origins, and true identity — the soul is completely re-formatted and wiped clean.
options.rationale: Full re-format erases past lives, cosmic origins, and true identity before redistribution.

options.label: B
options.text: Nothing — the portal only photographs the soul and stores a backup without deletion.
options.rationale: The soul is re-formatted; memories of past lives, origins, and true identity are wiped.

options.label: C
options.text: Only language skills, while identity and past-life archives remain fully conscious.
options.rationale: Wipe covers past lives, cosmic origins, and true identity entirely.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the last five minutes of conversation, leaving all past lives and cosmic origins intact.
options.rationale: All memories of past lives, cosmic origins, and true identity are entirely wiped clean.

questions.hint: Past lives + cosmic origins + true identity — fully wiped.

questions.question: Where is the wiped soul expelled for re-distribution after Sun processing?

options.label: A
options.text: Immediately expelled through portals situated deep within the 13 subterranean levels of the Vatican.
options.rationale: Vatican's 13 subterranean levels are the central parasitic hub for wiped-soul redistribution.

options.label: B
options.text: Directly into adult bodies already walking the street, skipping birth entirely forever.
options.rationale: Re-insertion targets newborn vessels after Vatican exit and Grey escort.

options.label: C
options.text: Through random clouds with no fixed hub and no parasitic operations center.
options.rationale: Expulsion is through portals in the 13 subterranean levels of the Vatican hub.

options.label: D
options.text: Only into the Moon station for permanent storage with no return to newborn vessels.
options.rationale: Path is Vatican distribution then Grey escort to birth insertion, not Moon storage alone.

questions.hint: 13 subterranean Vatican levels — parasitic central hub.

questions.question: How do Grey ETs complete Forced Insertion after the soul leaves the Vatican portals?

options.label: A
options.text: They mail the soul a paper map and wait years for voluntary travel with full memory.
options.rationale: Greys use phasing technology for rapid escort to a pre-selected birth country.

options.label: B
options.text: They destroy the soul so no insertion into any newborn vessel can ever occur.
options.rationale: They escort wiped souls to pre-selected regions for forced newborn insertion.

options.label: C
options.text: Using phasing technology, they quickly escort the soul to a pre-selected country where a mother is about to give birth.
options.rationale: Grey phasing escort → pre-selected country → tiny free-will window among local births.

options.label: D
options.text: They allow the soul to tour every country on Earth for decades before any birth choice.
options.rationale: Escort is quick to a pre-selected country with only a fraction of free will left.

questions.hint: Grey phasing — pre-selected country — fraction of free will among local births.

questions.question: When does the soul enter the baby, and how is the vessel ignited?

options.label: A
options.text: At the exact moment of birth, usually before the umbilical cord is cut.
options.rationale: Birth-moment entry before cord cut; Trillivolts from the soul ignite the heart.

options.label: B
options.text: The heart starts from random static with no soul entry before or after the cord is cut.
options.rationale: Soul entry and Trillivolt ignition are required at birth for the vessel heart.

options.label: C
options.text: Years after birth via a school ritual, with no electrical role for the soul at all.
options.rationale: Entry is at the exact moment of birth, usually before the umbilical cord is cut.

options.label: D
options.text: Only at age twenty-one when legal adulthood begins, long after the heart already beats alone.
options.rationale: Ignition of the heart is at birth entry via the soul's Trillivolt discharge.

questions.hint: Birth moment (before cord cut) — Trillivolts start the heart.

questions.question: How does the Sol/Soul portal dual-deception work with the Moon?

options.label: A
options.text: The Sun and Moon both act as healing stations, sending souls back with gentler memories so that their suffering is reduced over time.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sun recycles/wipes; Moon harvests loosh from the suffering of those wiped souls.

options.label: B
options.text: The Moon wipes the souls' memories at night, while the Sun gathers the Loosh by day, reversing the roles that most people assume.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sun recycles/wipes; Moon harvests loosh from the suffering of those wiped souls.

options.label: C
options.text: The Sun wipes souls for recycling, while the Moon is a mobile space station gathering the Loosh of those suffering, memory-wiped souls.
options.rationale: Sun recycles/wipes; Moon harvests loosh from the suffering of those wiped souls.

options.label: D
options.text: Neither body interacts with souls; both are weather lamps on the dome, and the wipe is handled by Grey ETs beneath the Vatican.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sun recycles/wipes; Moon harvests loosh from the suffering of those wiped souls.

questions.hint: Sun wipes/recycles; Moon mobile station harvests loosh from sufferers.

questions.question: Where is the wiped soul expelled before re-insertion into the realm?

options.label: A
options.text: Through the central valve at Mt Meru.
options.rationale: Mt Meru is the realm's central node, not the soul-distribution hub named here.

options.label: B
options.text: Through portals deep within the 13 subterranean levels of the Vatican.
options.rationale: The report states the wiped soul is expelled through portals situated deep within the 13 subterranean levels of the Vatican, a central hub for parasitic operations.

options.label: C
options.text: Through the lunar station's docking shell.
options.rationale: The Moon station gathers loosh; souls exit processing through the Vatican portals.

options.label: D
options.text: Through breaches in the Ice Wall at Antarctica.
options.rationale: The Ice Wall partitions the realm's geography; it is not the soul exit route.

questions.question: How does the linguistic deception of "Sol-ar Systems" act as a psychological perimeter?

options.label: A
options.text: Selling “solar systems” as physical star-planet machines hides that a true Sol-System is a soul family of connected souls and keeps minds locked in globe-orbit cosmology.
options.rationale: Globe-and-star "solar system" language hides that your soul family shares the same prison wipe cycle.

options.label: B
options.text: Schools openly teach that Sol means soul farm, so every child rejects globe cosmology and refuses Sun-portal reincarnation logistics.
options.rationale: It masks that an actual Sol-System (soul family) is trapped alongside you in the same wipe loop.

options.label: C
options.text: Controllers removed the word Sol from all languages so no linguistic deception about soul farms or fake orbit stories remains possible.
options.rationale: The deception conceals soul family imprisonment behind fake orbital cosmology.

options.label: D
options.text: “Solar” language only describes weather and seasons with no cosmological deception and no soul-architecture implications whatsoever.
options.rationale: It is a psychological perimeter hiding trapped soul-family reality.

questions.hint: Globe-orbit story hides trapped Sol-System soul families in the wipe loop.

questions.question: What fraction of free will does the soul retain at re-insertion?

options.label: A
options.text: Full free will to choose any birth on the planet.
options.rationale: The choice is narrowly confined to one pre-selected region's available births.

options.label: B
options.text: None at all; even the parent is assigned by the Greys.
options.rationale: The report grants the soul a small, quick choice among the available births.

options.label: C
options.text: Only enough to quickly choose a parent from the immediately available births in that specific region.
options.rationale: The report states the soul possesses only a fraction of free will to quickly choose a parent from the immediately available births in the pre-selected region.

options.label: D
options.text: Free will over the timing, but not the location, of birth.
options.rationale: The timing is forced (15 to 20 minutes); the limited choice concerns the parent.

questions.question: What did the Galactic Ancestral Alliance accomplish regarding the Amnesia Vortex in 2019?

options.label: A
options.text: It removed the Amnesia Vortex — newly incarnated children are no longer wiped and keep past-life memories and their missions.
options.rationale: 2019 G.A.A. removal of the vortex lets children keep past-life memory and mission recall.

options.label: B
options.text: It moved the vortex from the Sun to the Moon, so that the memory wipe now happens at night instead of at the moment of birth.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. 2019 G.A.A. removal of the vortex lets children keep past-life memory and mission recall.

options.label: C
options.text: It weakened the vortex gradually, so that children lose their memories more slowly and recover them during their teenage years.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. 2019 G.A.A. removal of the vortex lets children keep past-life memory and mission recall.

options.label: D
options.text: It placed shields around Star Seed families, protecting their children while the vortex still wipes the rest of the population.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. 2019 G.A.A. removal of the vortex lets children keep past-life memory and mission recall.

questions.hint: 2019 G.A.A. removed Amnesia Vortex — children keep past-life memory.

questions.question: What does the soul do in the first seconds after entering the baby?

options.label: A
options.text: It seals the vessel's memory of its past life.
options.rationale: The memory wipe happened earlier, inside the portal; at entry the soul's task is ignition.

options.label: B
options.text: It uses Trillivolts of electrical interaction to start the baby's heart.
options.rationale: The report states the soul enters at the moment of birth, usually before the umbilical cord is cut, and uses Trillivolts of electrical interaction to start the baby's heart.

options.label: C
options.text: It chooses whether to remain or return to the Sun.
options.rationale: No such choice is offered; entry and ignition are immediate.

options.label: D
options.text: It signals the Grey ETs that insertion is complete.
options.rationale: The Greys escort the soul TO the birth; the ignition is the soul's own act.

questions.question: What are newly incarnated children now doing, since the vortex's removal in 2019?

options.label: A
options.text: Being born without a soul's ignition of the heart.
options.rationale: Ignition still occurs; what changed is the memory wipe no longer precedes it.

options.label: B
options.text: Retaining past life memories and recalling their true spiritual missions.
options.rationale: The report states that since the G.A.A. removed the Amnesia Vortex technology in 2019, newly incarnated children are no longer memory-wiped, and young children are retaining past life memories and recalling their true spiritual missions.

options.label: C
options.text: Waiting in higher realms for their Twin Flames.
options.rationale: That describes the natural order the portal once blocked, not the noted phenomenon among children now.

options.label: D
options.text: Refusing reincarnation entirely.
options.rationale: Children are still incarnating — but with their memories intact.

questions.question: What escorts the wiped soul to the pre-selected country of birth?

options.label: A
options.text: The Vatican's terrestrial clergy network.
options.rationale: The Vatican hosts the exit portals; the escort is not its clergy.

options.label: B
options.text: Benevolent Masters from the higher light realms.
options.rationale: The escort belongs to the parasitic operation, not the Masters.

options.label: C
options.text: Grey ETs, using their phasing technology.
options.rationale: The report states Grey ETs utilize their phasing technology to quickly escort the soul to a pre-selected country where a mother is about to give birth.

options.label: D
options.text: The soul's own Twin Flame, travelling alongside.
options.rationale: Twin Flames are separated by this system, not employed as escorts within it.
